features.text: Patient has a history of smoking starting in high school, initially experimenting with friends and at parties, and now smokes a pack and a half daily.
Patient has not used any other type of tobacco products besides cigarettes.
Patient smokes the first cigarette within an hour of waking up.
Patient has a history of type two diabetes and gout.
Patient is currently pregnant and expecting a child soon.
Patient previously attempted to quit smoking cold turkey and was successful for almost a year before relapsing due to work-related stress.
Patient has started learning meditation and recently joined a gym as stress relief strategies.
Patient is considering using a nicotine patch as a smoking cessation aid.
Patient has chosen next Monday, their birthday, as their quit date.
Patient's vital signs include blood pressure of 128/88 mmHg, heart rate of 68 bpm, respirations of 16 per minute, and oxygen saturation of 98% on room air.
Patient has a systolic murmur (2/6) that is being monitored.
Patient's lungs are clear with no expiratory wheezes, rales, or rhonchi.
Patient has no lymphadenopathy or carotid bruit detected during the physical exam.
